_readme: MORE MUSIC (SOUNDS 10/24/26, row [more music, on the one beat], rule 158(d); Paolo 10/24: 'a big thing is we need more music'). One row in the shape of his MLOOPS rows, his THE VAULT's own row with 3 fields changed, each taken from one of his canon songs (provenance), played by his own engine with REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY's machine playing along (engine/bohemia_machine_party.js, the kit in slices/vote/songs/machine_party_kit/). Made by tools/bohemia_sounds_more_music.js; gate gates/more_music_gate.js. Never in MLOOPS on disk, never in the fence or CAT_DEFAULTS, until his YES (rule 122(d)).
name: THE CASHIER'S CAGE
story: the casino cashier's cage behind its bars, a machine still counting money that is worth nothing

inst.l: the rotting viola from his casino song, in place of the dusk organ (A GASP IN THE VAULT's paper lung was tried first and measured 34 dB under the mix on a phone, his VAULT's tune 17: buried, so it went)
am: a held breath under beat one, in place of the ledger bell
mel: his REPO MAN's call and answer, in place of the long notes
acc: its colour in the MUSIC tab, the lead's song's

analog_horror_at_the_source: the tune is his engine's, drawn from the name, on rotviola (THE LAST DEALER FOLDS)
under every bar nightpad, and on beat one of the core chapelbreath: the rooms the song is set in, from his own voices
the beat arrives late (no drums for the first eight bars on the map, his 9/12 rule) and his strip sections leave only the kick and the bass

the machine is REPO MAN THE MACHINE PARTY's, real recordings of real machines (a train coupling, an electromechanical clock, steel, a washing machine's motor in the song's key), in one concrete hall on a worn tape: the wear is in what plays, no noise is added (NO SAND)

press.on: his kick (drumV with the row's kit.k)
press.is: a coupling slamming between two train wagons

relay.on: his hat (drumV with the row's kit.h)

party.is: the press on beats two and four in his D sections: four to the bar

clank.is: steel on steel on the and of two, every other bar

motor.is: a washing machine's motor whining in this song's key (+0 semitones from REPO MAN's G3), changing speed with his key moves; louder in his C sections, where the song strips to kick and bass

hall.is: one concrete hall, 10 x 18 x 7 m, the machine wetter than the music

tape.is: the from-a-recording tool's tape: a head bump, a soft tanh, wow and flutter, a gentle 2:1, a 9 kHz top

machine.from: slices/vote/songs/repo_man_the_machine_party.json (his YES 10/19, sounds-repo-man-the-machine-party-10-19), every number but the motor's key

card.title: A NEW NIGHT SONG: THE CASHIER'S CAGE
card.why: You said we need more music, so this is a new night song made in your songs' own machine: your song THE VAULT with a rotting viola from your song THE LAST DEALER FOLDS, a held breath from your song A GASP IN THE VAULT and a call and answer tune from your REPO MAN, the casino cashier's cage behind its bars, a machine still counting money that is worth nothing, with the REPO MAN machine party playing along in the concrete hall on a worn tape. You hear it on this page over the real map, A the new song beside B your song THE VAULT and C your song THE PIT BOSS IS GONE at the same loudness on a phone, on the 120 beat, and it is not in the game until you say yes (EYES AND EARS' line is owed, rule 119(c); rule 158(d) put it here).
options: A, THE CASHIER'S CAGE joins your night songs
